title: I downgraded from an iPhone X to an iPhone 8 - and I think I like the less expensive phone more (AAPL)
text: I downgraded from an iPhone X to an iPhone 8 — and I think I like the less expensive phone more (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Nov 13, 2018, 9:00 am 21 pts I really liked my iPhone X. For about a year, I was on Apple's bleeding edge: I used Face ID to unlock my phone, I swiped up to change apps, and I generally enjoyed what Apple said was the "future of the smartphone."
